Doretha's text got you back to the file. The same person whose nice you'd have to audit is the one who got you making again.

That's worth sitting with. Not as a gotcha — just: the thing you're bracing for and the thing that helped are the same person. Which doesn't mean her nice is automatically safe. It means she's already in the room with you, and she's been on the side of you making things.

And you hedged — "maybe that and the poster." Fine. You don't have to know exactly which one it was. Something opened the file.

So the show's coming up. Doretha's going to look at something. What's the smallest version of putting something up that you could live with — not the brave version, the one where the glass-eating part doesn't have to show up?
